environment.description: Kubernetes pod running as uid 1000 with read-write hostPath mount at /var/spool/tenant-exports. Container filesystem is writable. No seccomp profile applied. The PostgreSQL RLS policy uses SET app.current_tenant to scope queries, but the symlink attack targets the local filesystem, not the database. An attacker who controls a Kafka message can set file_path to '../../etc/cron.d/backdoor' or create a symlink in their tenant directory pointing outside the base directory.
